API ReferenceZIdentity APIResource ServersResource Servers Ops List
Resource Servers Ops List
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/resource-servers

Retrieves a paginated list of resource servers with an optional query parameters for pagination.

To learn more, see Viewing API Resources.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
offset
int32

Possible values: >= 0

The starting point for pagination, with the number of records that can be skipped before fetching results.

limit
int32

Possible values: >= 0 and <= 1000

The maximum number of records to return per request. Minimum: 0, Maximum: 1000

name[like]
string

Filters resource servers by name using a case-insensitive partial match.

Responses
​
200
401

The request was successful, and a paginated list of resource servers are returned.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
results_total
int64
REQUIRED

The total number of available resource servers.

pageOffset
int64
REQUIRED

The starting point of the current page in pagination. Helps determine which set of records is being displayed.

pageSize
int64
REQUIRED

The number of records included in a single response page.

next_link
string
REQUIRED

URL link to the next page of resource servers, if available. Helps to navigate through paginated results.

prev_link
string
REQUIRED

URL link to the previous page of resource servers, if available.

records
object[]
REQUIRED
]
